_about: Every earthwork truth case tests/test_earthwork_regress.py replays. One entry per case; add a DEM-derived truth sheet by adding an entry, not by editing the test. Fields: id; sheet (human name, engine page index AND printed sheet); kind = how the inputs are read (fixture: one committed JSON like earthwork_oncor_c04_inputs.json; seed_flips: the offline-recipe folder layout under out/verify with seed/result/flips/boundary files); via = server runs the entry THROUGH THE PRODUCT (server.earthwork_calc, the POST /earthwork route function, over a throwaway TAKEOFF_JOBS_DIR; needs page = engine page index; runs then take boundary, spots, existing_layers / proposed_layers as [{name, thickness_in}] and scale_ft_per_in = a reviewer-typed scale sidecar, and NEVER cell_ft or surface_model - the server's defaults are the point); source = where the row set and its verification live; baseline = the expectation file, committed under tests/baselines/ ONLY for non-client data - client work keeps it gitignored beside its inputs; runs = the cut_fill configurations (boundary: recipe | shrunk75 | null; surface_model; cell_ft; existing_offset_ft / proposed_offset_ft; spots = N proposed spot points). compare = the comparison kind, DECLARED on every entry and repeated inside its baseline, never inferred from what a file lacks: recipe = EXACT floats, the baseline must carry earthwork_sig and cut_yd3/fill_yd3/net_yd3 on every case and is written only by --accept; tolerance = a TRUTH case whose numbers came from outside the engine (a DEM differencing, a client's own takeoff), the entry must carry tolerance_yd3 and/or tolerance_pct > 0, its baseline is hand-written {"compare": "tolerance", "source": ..., "cases": {run-name: {cut_yd3, fill_yd3, net_yd3}}} with all three numbers on every case, and --accept refuses it. enabled = false parks an entry visibly (printed as DISABLED); a manifest with zero enabled entries FAILS, and so does a run that compares zero fields. Gitignored inputs that are absent print SKIPPED and are counted, never silently passed.
